user_authorization: Continue full causal input processing and exclude unusable windows, retaining original raw data and time/index identities. No model training, deployment activation or score-based exclusions.
scope: All 3135 source train/val, 553 internal SIL/HIL test and 465 frozen-role Real cases already label-reviewed, 4153 total. Original processed crop grid, split membership, simulation pairs, original cap64 window selections and Real roles fixed. Do not add 28 out-of-role Real, open set or 31-channel assets.
rule: Reuse verified 26-channel causal_pipeline, original ULog messages, last published available record at or before original 20ms grid time, valid explicit observation clocks, no interpolation/backfill/zero fill/clock sorting. Availability=original ULog publication timestamp is a replay proxy, NOT actual physical transport receive time.
no_retuning: Apply pilot budgets unchanged across full data, report coverage without widening to improve scores or counts. User authorization expands processing scope, not validation of physical freshness tolerances.
input_exclusion: Exclude any existing selected window with any missing/stale/nonfinite required input frame or unresolved original clock/provenance. Keep original case/grid/window IDs and reasons in full ledgers. Clock/data-identity failures stay explicitly quarantined, never implicit zero or interpolation. Unusable windows omitted only from compact source train/val consumers.
label_exclusion: Retain existing label reference convention and mask. Supervised eligibility=whole-window input-valid AND endpoint-label-valid. No -1 to old loss, no resampling replacements. Real9 bag failures remain label quarantine even if ULog feature input parses. Real roles not remapped.
historical_RflySim_suffix: All 3680 old train suffix indices recorded separately as excluded from this causal version for missing demonstrated per-topic source/availability timing. No silently reusing legacy X, no invented case identities, no claiming prior source quality is newly certified. Their old X/y and protocol remain untouched.
normalization: Fit only qualified original cap64 source train windows from the full causal rebuild. Per-window relative altitude before float32, acc_norm same-frame. Freeze new versioned statistics before val/test/Real cache normalization checks; never fit on val/test/Real, never overwrite old stats. Do not use pilot coefficients as full data stats.
outputs: Full per-case causal grid and masks plus source provenance; old-index and exclusion ledger for every cap64 input. Compact source train/val x/y with mapping. Internal test and Real all-role evidence have unknown masks and no generic y; no mixing old test.pt. Preserve all frame timelines for replay even when no inference possible. New manifests enforce schema/version/hash admission.
validation: Regression tests, full selected-window identities against saved original membership and legacy y; no-future provenance and input masks on every saved case; verify cache build normalization and multiple source windows. Compare new actual normalized tensors against stateful adapter on fixed representative train/val raw cases, including the known gaps. Source-only rule is not real network test.
